Window Film for Homes & Buildings: What to Know

01 Up to 98%heat blocked

How Solar Control Film Cools a Room

Most of the heat that comes through glass is infrared. A nano ceramic solar control film reflects and absorbs it at the window, so far less heat reaches the room.

Daylight still comes in, so rooms stay bright — and the AC has less work to do.

Get a free quote
02 SafetyHolds glass

Safety & Security Film for Glass

Safety film bonds to the glass, so if a pane breaks the pieces stay together instead of falling into the room.

Thicker security films also slow down break-ins — useful for ground-floor villas, shopfronts and offices.

Get a free quote
03 PrivacyBy day

Privacy, Reflective or Blackout?

Reflective film gives a mirror look from outside during the day. Privacy film darkens the view in. Blackout film stops all light — for bedrooms, cinemas and storage.

Tell us the room and we recommend the right one — many buildings mix several.
